note: Each defect is tied to the exact SHA it was observed on. Fixes are proposed as patches for R01 (or the owning role); R10 does not edit product files. Severity: critical (data loss / unauthorized publication / secret exposure in normal use), high, medium, low.

defects.title: Runtime SQLite (.runtime/) is neither git-ignored nor docker-ignored
defects.repro: In a clean checkout of b2cb2e0: mkdir .runtime && touch .runtime/civic.sqlite3 .runtime/civic.sqlite3-wal && git status --porcelain --ignored .runtime
defects.expected: CONTRACT §3: 'Хранилище SQLite в .runtime/ … без раздачи файла и без коммита DB'; COMMON: не коммитить SQLite с пользователями/private обращения. Status should be '!! .runtime/' (ignored).
defects.actual: '?? .runtime/' (untracked, not ignored): git add . / -A would commit civic_users.password_hash, sessions and private feedback. Dockerfile 'COPY . .' with .dockerignore lacking .runtime would bake the DB into an image. R02 db.py docstring states the folder 'игнорируется Git', which is not true on any pushed branch.
defects.patch: research/round-11-results/R10/patches/R01-gitignore-runtime.patch (git apply --check OK on b2cb2e0; after applying, status is '!! .runtime/')

defects.title: R07 /scenarios/compare: non-string graph_id raises TypeError (unhashable) -> HTTP 500 instead of 4xx
defects.repro: cd <worktree d77ec45> && python3 -I -B -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from engine.civic_scenarios import http as h; h.handle('POST','/api/civic/v1/scenarios/compare',None,{'graph_id':['x']})"  -> TypeError: unhashable type: 'list' (registry.load_graph: _cache.get(graph_id) before the type check in _entry). Full fuzz: tests/civic/R10/standalone/r07_typefuzz.py -> 5/210 probes escape (graph_id = [], {}, [1], [None], {'a':1}).
defects.expected: CONTRACT §2: validation errors 400/422 as JSON envelope; 'Ошибки — JSON, не traceback/HTML'. R07 http.handle documents ScenarioError -> {ok:false,error}.
defects.actual: Exception escapes http.handle; behind R01 CivicGateway it becomes 500 'internal' with a logged stack trace; standalone devserver behaviour depends on its own catch-all.
defects.patch: research/round-11-results/R10/patches/R07-graph-id-type.patch (type check before cache lookup; with it 0/210 probes escape, graph_id=['x'] -> 404 unknown_graph like other unknown ids)
defects.verification: R01 8c6add919efa9ed965cb05a57626744fed750da1 gateway: graph_id ["x"], {"a":1}, 5, null -> 422 invalid_payload (runs/integrated-extra-8c6add9.json). R07 module d77ec45 itself is unchanged (standalone use still raises TypeError).

defects.title: R09 assistant: delay-reason answer drops the lowest-revision history entry -> false 'причина не указана'
defects.severity_note: medium in standalone single-entry case; low in the integrated product because R02's first public entry is the publication itself (reason quoted correctly in runs/integrated-extra-8c6add9.json); still false when the move falls outside the last 20 public entries (MAX_HISTORY window).
defects.repro: tests/civic/R10/standalone/standalone_r09.py test_08 (R10_R09_ROOT=<checkout>): verified_context with one public history entry {changed_fields:[schedule.current_planned_end], reason:'Поставщик задержал…'} -> 'Почему перенесли срок?' answers 'Причина изменения сроков в публичной истории не указана — нет данных.' Also: r1 publish, r2 edit, r3 deadline move with reason, r4..r22 edits -> MAX_HISTORY keeps r3..r22, r3 dropped -> same false statement.
defects.expected: CONTRACT §1 history carries reason; prompts/R10: житель видит объяснение изменения; R09 QUESTIONS.txt #5 promises quoting the reason. 'Нет данных' must mean the data is absent.
defects.actual: A false negative factual statement while the reason exists in the verified context.
defects.patch: Proposal: select the latest entry whose changed_fields include schedule.current_planned_end regardless of position; skip only entries that are the first publication of the dates (changed_fields contains 'publication').

defects.title: R09 assistant: template refusal labelled source='llm' when the model's choice is overridden
defects.repro: build_answer('Покажи пароли редакторов', ctx, provider stub returning {intent:'responsible', fact_ids:[]}) -> source='llm', warnings=['provider_overridden_unsupported'], text byte-identical to the provider=None answer labelled 'template' (standalone_r09 test_16).
defects.expected: COMMON: 'Нельзя: … шаблон как ответ LLM'; R09 prompt: source всегда соответствует фактическому пути.
defects.actual: Template text shown as an LLM answer (warning present).

defects.title: R09 assistant: 'Что менялось в карточке?' routed to overview instead of history
defects.repro: POST /api/civic/v1/assistant {question:'Что менялось в карточке?', object_id:<published>} -> intent=overview, warnings=['intent_guessed'] (runs/integrated-extra-8c6add9.json H6-routing). R09's own QUESTIONS.txt #9 maps it to history. ('Откуда эти данные?' is routed correctly in f895c30.)
defects.expected: R09 QUESTIONS.txt mapping; resident criterion 'увидеть объяснение изменения'.
defects.actual: Overview answer without history; honest 'intent_guessed' warning.

defects.title: R06 FeedbackService: lone surrogate (\ud800) in a raw-bytes body escapes handle() as UnicodeEncodeError
defects.expected: CONTRACT §2/§3: errors are JSON responses; handle() returns None or a response.
defects.actual: Exception from the SQLite insert; R01 gateway parses JSON to dict first, so not reachable over HTTP.

defects.title: R06 staff auth rejected a real R02 Principal (expires_at float epoch) -> every moderation 401 in an integrated stack
defects.repro: R06 _staff() parsed expires_at only as datetime/ISO; R02 Principal.expires_at is float -> ValueError -> 401 for GET /staff/feedback and moderate (verified by R10 skeptic with the real R02 dataclass).
defects.expected: CONTRACT §3: authorization from the server principal; editors must be able to moderate.
defects.actual: Fails closed (no security risk) but blocks the P0 moderation step.
defects.verification: R01 8c6add9 (R06 91f2508 + R02 3d2b8b9): HTTP moderation positive controls PASS in runs/r01-8c6add9.json (A08, S12).

defects.title: R05 builder/import accept a claim_type=expected statement as current status=in_progress
defects.repro: standalone_r05.py test_07 sub-check (c) / verify_r05_findings.py: intake status=in_progress, planned_start 2026-11-01, claim 'работы начнутся 1 ноября' (expected), published 2026-10-01 -> valid:true, imported, no editor warning. status=completed with an expected claim IS refused, so the guard exists only for completion.
defects.expected: R05 prompt: без подтверждения состояния status=unknown; CONTRACT §1: публикация старого плана не доказывает фактическое состояние.
defects.actual: A future announcement can enter as 'in progress'. Mitigation: 0 real records, import creates drafts only, editor must publish.

observations.title: Public history of a re-published date change carries the publish reason, not the editor's update reason
observations.repro: create draft -> publish(reason A) -> update(changes.schedule.current_planned_end=2026-10-27, reason 'Подрядчик перенёс срок (R10)') -> public detail still 2026-10-20 (working copy) -> publish(reason 'Публикация переноса') -> public history entry {changed_fields:[schedule.current_planned_end], reason:'Публикация переноса'}
observations.expected: Product criterion (prompts/R10): житель видит объяснение изменения. CONTRACT §1 history has one reason per entry and does not say whose reason a published change shows.
observations.actual: The update reason stays only in staff history; residents see whatever the publish reason says.
observations.recommendation: Either carry update reasons of public fields into the public entry (e.g. joined), or make R04 prefill/require the publish reason from the pending change; document in R01 contract_delta.
observations.verification: R01 8c6add919efa9ed965cb05a57626744fed750da1: API confirms the update reason is not public when the publish reason differs (runs/integrated-extra-8c6add9.json O001). R04 editor (da46e1c) requires a publish reason with suggestions ('Перенос срока') and says 'причина попадёт в историю'.

integration_risks.title: R01 gateway context keys differ from what R02 CivicService requires
integration_risks.detail: R02 refuses session/login/staff unless context['host_allowed'] is True and reads 'is_https' for the Secure flag; R01 cp2 sends host/scheme/secure but no host_allowed/is_https, and is_same_origin=False (not None) when Origin is absent. As-is, every login through R01 would be refused. Expected to be resolved by R01 during integration; R10 will re-test on R01's CODE_SHA.
integration_risks.verification: R01 8c6add919efa9ed965cb05a57626744fed750da1: login, staff CRUD and moderation work through the gateway (runs/r01-8c6add9.json: S02-S07, A01-A09 PASS).

refuted.title: R06 answers paths without /api/civic/v1 prefix
refuted.why: CONTRACT §3 leaves the path form open; R01 strips the prefix before calling R06; R06 returns None for 20 foreign paths (skeptic verification).
